newsitem.title: USA: NJ jury rejects execution for man who killed kids.
newsitem.headline: NJ jury rejects execution for man who killed kids.

text.p: A New Jersey jury Monday rejected the death penalty for a man who pleaded guilty to killing his two children because he feared his ex-wife would not raise them as Jews.
Avi Kostner, 52, will be sentenced to a minimum of 30 years without parole to life in prison May 6 by Bergen County Superior Court Judge Jonathan Harris in Hackensack, New Jersey.

Kostner, who remains in jail, pleaded guilty to killing his children, Beth, 12, and Ryan 10, on June 26, 1994. He murdered them after a seven-year long custody battle with his ex-wife who was ready to take the children to Florida.
Kostner's attorneys claimed he was mentally ill when he committed the crimes.
